title: Exec staff meeting prep notes - 2026-03-23
content:
Agenda (30m)
- Quick metric pulse (5m): latency P50/P95, hosted spend, Dedicated utilization
- Top risks & outages (5m): SRE/infra brief
- Product priorities (8m): Hosted API roadmap + Private onboarding cadence
- GTM ask (5m): Dedicated renewals & ARR motion
- Decisions needed (5m): burst policy for Dedicated customers; model fallback SLA

Notes / talking points
- Metrics snapshot (ask SRE to confirm numbers live)
  - P50 latency: ~42ms (stable)
  - P95 latency: spiked to 420ms on 2026-03-21 during batch release (see incident ticket JIRA-1234)
  - Hosted API token spend trending +18% MoM; embeddings high for one enterprise customer (acct: CUST-PLAT-88)
  - Dedicated utilization: 74% average across pools, some pools at 95% (eu-west-1 gpu-pool-2)

- Incident summary (SRE)
  - 2026-03-21 spike linked to kernel update in runtime (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/256)
  - Mitigation: roll back kernel, re-run performance tests, temporary autoscale adjustment
  - Follow-up owner: Miguel Santos -> action: full postmortem and remediation plan by 2026-03-25

- Product / Hosting priorities
  - Private onboarding: 2 customers in final eval, blockers are KMS integration and network validation; need to confirm timelines for pilot (ask Legal + Security to accelerate attestation)
  - Rollouts: want to enable canary % configs per route in Console (low effort, high value for reducing incidents)
  - Decision: enable route-level canaries by default? pros/cons quick note
    - PRO: reduces blast radius for model changes
    - CON: complexity for customers, UI overhead
  - Owner: Jordan Lee to present minimal UI pattern and migration plan in next week

- GTM / Renewals
  - Dedicated renewals: two accounts up for renewal end of Q2, need executive sponsor outreach (ask: Sales to provide contract status by Friday)
  - Pricing ask: present an optional preemptible discount for Dedicated burst capacity (helps utilization); need quick S&OP on economics (ask Finance + Product)

Decisions / asks for exec meeting
- Approve limited preemptible discount for burst capacity pilot (3-month pilot) -> need thumbs up from CEO + Finance
- Approve additional headcount for SRE (1 IC) to cover Dedicated on-call load (hire in Q2)
- Approve canary-by-default experiment for Console (if no blockers from Product/Design)

Open questions / risks
- If Dedicated peak pools hit >95% again during region outages, do we have cross-region fallback policy? (routing team to confirm capability)
- Legal: private deployment contract patterns for EU data residency — any late blockers from customers under review?
- Quality regressions: recent model variant quantization caused small ROUGE drop for one customer evaluation — product to scope rollback criteria

Action items (owner + due date)
- Miguel Santos: full postmortem for 2026-03-21 latency spike (due 2026-03-25)
- Jordan Lee: canary-by-route UI design + migration proposal (due 2026-03-30)
- Alex Kim (Sales): provide renewal status + executive sponsor names for two Q2 Dedicated renewals (due 2026-03-26)
- Priya Rao: send executive outreach email templates for renewals + schedule 30-min sponsor intro slots (due 2026-03-24)
- Product (owner TBD): propose preemptible burst economics and risk doc (due 2026-03-27)
- Security (Samira Patel): confirm KMS onboarding checklist for Private pilot customers (due 2026-03-26)

Prep / quick lines for CEO
- TL;DR: minor incident last week (kernel update) caused perf spike; rollback done; postmortem due Fri. Dedicated utilization healthy but some pools near capacity — propose burst discount pilot to improve utilization and reduce renewal friction. Recommend green-light for canary-by-route experiment.
- Ask: sign-off on 3-month burst pilot + approval to hire 1 SRE IC for Dedicated ops.

Notes to self (talking cues)
- Keep incident description high-level; defer technical deep-dive to SRE owner unless asked
- Emphasize customer renewals as revenue-lever + low-effort pilot to improve utilization
- Flag EU data residency unblock as high priority for next week

Misc / references
- Incident ticket: JIRA-1234
- Kernel PR: github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/256
- Confluence: CONFLUENCE-ENG-Q1-REVIEW (link)

Scratchpad / follow-ups for 1:1s
- 1:1 with Miguel (2026-03-24): review postmortem outline, confirm remediation tasks, discuss out-of-band oncall shifts
- 1:1 with Jordan (2026-03-25): product tradeoffs on canary defaults, timeline for Console changes
- 1:1 with Alex (2026-03-24): renewal negotiation tactics and exec intro plan

Status: keep as draft until PMs and SRE confirm numbers.
